## Change and reason

Controlling milestone and scope:

## Evidence

- [ ] Behavior change has a failing regression recorded before its implementation.
- [ ] Relevant local checks passed; exact commands, counts and skips are below.
- [ ] Hosted acceptance, when required, binds the exact final tree.
- [ ] Failed runs and their causes/corrections are retained; no blind rerun.
- [ ] Public upstream facts/licenses are verified and linked.
- [ ] No private Brain data, credentials, user paths or machine configuration.
- [ ] Authority, containment, recovery and unrelated-file boundaries preserved.

Commands/results, exact tested commit/run and limitations:

## Review and release boundaries

Documentation-only changes may mark the regression item not applicable with a
reason. Do not mark a human walkthrough, live runtime, setting or publication gate
complete from simulation. Account/repository settings, runner removal, visibility,
tags/releases and final provenance remain maintainer actions.
